subject: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline
body:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 9:12 AM PT
Subject: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline
Attachments: GuidedOnboarding_Kickoff_Agenda_2026-01-14.pdf

Team —

Kicking off the guided onboarding checklist + “first production launch” path for Hosted API. Goal is to reduce time-to-first-success (signup → first successful response) and make the path to production more explicit + measurable.

Proposed working plan (high-level):
- Discovery: 2–3 wks (funnel + support tickets + ~6 user interviews)
- Definition: 2 wks (PRD + UX spec + telemetry schema + success metrics)
- Build: 4–6 wks (Console checklist behind flag + docs/quickstarts + SDK parity)
- Beta: 2–3 wks (subset of new signups + a few existing orgs)
- GA: 1–2 wks

Ownership proposal:
- Product requirements + launch criteria: Nikhil + Marissa (I’ll stay close)
- Console UX: Tessa (design), Kenji (execution)
- SDK snippet parity (auth/retries/streaming): Monica + Ibrahim
- Docs + info architecture + canonical URLs: Elliot + Wei/Jean-Paul
- Telemetry schema + dashboards: Logan + Nadia/Mei

Two decisions we need in kickoff:
1) What’s our Phase 1 “first production launch” definition (minimum safeguards vs recommended)?
2) What checklist steps are auto-validated vs manual acknowledgements in Phase 1?

Can you all reply with:
- Confirmed owner(s) + alternates
- Any timeline risks (esp. design/SDK/docs dependencies)
- Anything that should explicitly be out-of-scope for Phase 1

I’d like to hold a 45 min kickoff early next week. If you have preferences: Mon 10:30–11:15 PT or Tue 1:00–1:45 PT.

Thanks,
Alex

Alex Martinez
VP, Developer Experience
Redwood Inference


---

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 10:03 AM PT
Subject: Re: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline

Confirmed on design ownership.

A few notes/risks:
- We should lock the step list + required vs recommended content early (week 1–2 of definition), otherwise UX spec will churn.
- Strong preference for a persistent checklist surface (not a one-time modal) so users can come back after leaving to implement.
- We’ll need copy/microcopy decisions early; otherwise engineering ends up with placeholder strings that stick.

Ask: can we get a draft “initial checklist step list” (even rough) before kickoff? I want Kenji to start exploring components + step states.

Mon 10:30–11:15 PT works.

Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Head of Product Design


---

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 11:26 AM PT
Subject: Re: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline

Confirmed for SDK ownership (Monica + Ibrahim).

Key dependency callouts:
- If the checklist has any “validated” SDK-driven step (e.g., streaming session, structured output/tool calling), we need a stable snippet contract across Python/TS/Go.
- I’d like a single canonical “first request” snippet shape per language (auth, timeout, retries, request-id). Today docs/examples are a bit inconsistent.
- Timing: we can do parity updates in parallel with Console build, but we need the final step list + terminology by end of Definition week 1 to avoid rework.

Also: please keep “prod key vs test key” clear. This is a recurring 401 issue and should be a first-class step.

Mon 10:30 works.

Monica

Monica Patel
Director, SDK Engineering


---

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 12:14 PM PT
Subject: Re: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline

Confirmed for docs/IA ownership.

Two things to bake into definition:
1) Deep link strategy from Console → docs: we should use version-stable URLs + UTM conventions so we can attribute step click-through and avoid broken links during docs reorg.
2) “First production launch” page should be authoritative and reflect minimum safeguards (timeouts/retries, rate limits/quota behavior, basic monitoring, rollback guidance). If we treat it as a checklist “capstone,” we need to decide what’s required vs recommended.

Risks:
- If product/eng wants to validate too many steps automatically in Phase 1, we’ll create a mismatch between what docs say and what the UI can actually verify.
- We should be explicit that we will NOT collect customer prompt content in onboarding telemetry (just properties like step id + timestamps + high-level signals).

Mon 10:30 PT is good.

Elliot

Elliot Price
Director, Technical Documentation


---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 2:02 PM PT
Subject: Re: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline
Attachments: Onboarding_Checklist_Step_Brainstorm_2025-12.docx

Thanks all.

Attached is the rough step brainstorm doc from last month (not final). For kickoff, I’m proposing we align on the “Phase 1 step list” as:

A) Setup
1. Create API key (test)
2. Make first request (validated)

B) Build basics
3. Streaming basics (validated if possible)
4. Error handling: timeouts + retries (manual acknowledgement + link to SDK guidance)
5. Understand rate limits/quotas + 429 handling (manual acknowledgement + deep link)

C) Operate
6. View usage analytics dashboard (validated)
7. Create prod-mode key + lock env usage (validated)
8. First production launch: minimum safeguards + rollback plan (manual acknowledgement in Phase 1)

Re: out-of-scope for Phase 1 (explicit): Dedicated/Private onboarding, SSO/SAML setup, and “automated validation of every production readiness item.”

Next steps before kickoff:
- I’ll ask Nikhil/Marissa to confirm what “validated” means for first request + streaming (signal source + expected lag).
- Elliot: please start a strawman for URLs + UTM conventions.
- Monica: please outline the “snippet contract” requirements (what we need consistent across languages).
- Tessa: please have Kenji bring 2–3 UI patterns (sidebar vs card vs modal) + pros/cons.

Kickoff booked: Mon 10:30–11:15 PT.
Agenda is basically the attached PDF.

Alex


---

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, Jan 14, 2026 at 4:48 PM PT
Subject: Re: Guided onboarding checklist (Hosted API) — kickoff + owners + beta timeline

One more note before we wrap today:

Success criteria for beta (proposal, open for debate):
- Reduce median signup → first successful response by 25% in beta cohort
- Increase completion of steps 1–3 (key + first request + streaming) by 15% within 7 days of signup
- Telemetry health: <2% missing event rate per region/day; end-to-end lag <15 minutes for step state updates

We’ll hash this out with PM in kickoff, but wanted to anchor on measurable outcomes.

Alex
